title: configdiff-js
tagline: Structural config comparison with risk-aware findings and built-in secret redaction.
highlights: Compares env, JSON, YAML and TOML structurally, not line by line
Documented rules flag risky changes: auth off, staging values in production, public secrets
Secrets are redacted from every report, so CI logs stay safe
Works offline: no account, no telemetry, never executes your config
